put.description: Save the firm's name and organisation details. Firm admins only.

get.description: The provider's embedding models LiteLLM knows, with their size and price.

post.description: Probes the model with one short text first, so a bad key or size is refused here.

put.description: Applies to documents uploaded from now on; indexed documents keep their model.

get.description: The models the current member may pick for a document upload.
The caller's own collections, the default first (made on first use).

delete.description: Its documents move to the default collection.

get.description: The largest file an upload may be, for the picker's own check.

put.description: Super admin: the largest file any member may upload.

get.description: What the in-app reader shows: the PDF or image itself, or the file's extracted text.

post.description: Confirm Smart Digest's analyzed plan, optionally changed, and start indexing.

put.description: Set or clear the provider's key, or switch the provider off.

get.description: The provider's chat models LiteLLM knows, with their limits and price.

post.description: Unset limits come from LiteLLM's table. The first model becomes the default.
Sends one tiny request through the stored key; fails with the provider's error.

get.description: The models a member may pick in the assistant.
Newest first. Pinned to the caller's firm whatever `firm_id` says.
The caller's agents and the firm's shared ones, most recently changed first.

post.description: Rewrite rough notes into a clear system prompt. Does not save the agent.

get.description: Files the caller cannot see are listed as not visible, without their names.

delete.description: Owner only. Past usage stays in the ledger.

get.description: The caller's own conversations, most recent first.

patch.description: Title, model, answering agent, and the settings gear (agents, files, connectors).

delete.description: Removes the conversation with its messages and artifacts. Usage stays in the ledger.

get.description: Oldest first: the newest `limit` messages before `before`.
The current version, or an earlier one by number.

post.description:
Send a message and stream the reply. The reply keeps going if the stream drops;
follow it again with the events endpoint, or reload the messages.

get.description:
Events of a turn after `Last-Event-ID`. When the turn is no longer held here, the
stream ends at once: `complete` if it had finished, `failed` if a restart cut it off
(it is closed as failed). Either way, reload the messages.

post.description:
Approve or deny an action waiting on a confirmation card. `allow_chat` approves it
and runs later actions in this chat without asking.

parameters.name: namespace

schema.title: Category

AccessLevel.title: AccessLevel
AccessLevel.description: What the current user may do with a document, strongest first.

calls.title: Calls
calls.description: Model calls made for this agent in the window.

unavailable_toolkits.title: Unavailable Toolkits
unavailable_toolkits.description: Attached connectors the viewer's catalog no longer offers.

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: For the owner: what other members will not get.

AgentDocumentResponse.title: AgentDocumentResponse
AgentDocumentResponse.description: A file the agent brings. When the viewer cannot see it, only `visible = false` is told.

AgentScope.title: AgentScope
AgentScope.description: `all`: every agent the caller may use. `mine`: theirs. `firm`: colleagues' shared ones.

is_connected.title: Is Connected
is_connected.description: The viewer's own connection. Null when it could not be checked.

AgentUpdate.title: AgentUpdate
AgentUpdate.description: Every field optional; `documents` and `toolkits`, when sent, replace the whole set.

AgentVisibility.title: AgentVisibility
AgentVisibility.description: `private`: the owner only. `firm`: every member may use it; only the owner edits.

AuthSpec.title: AuthSpec
AuthSpec.description: How a call authenticates. Every value is a template, usually `{{token}}`.

AuthTrigger.title: AuthTrigger
AuthTrigger.description:
When a flow runs: the first time an environment is used, after a 401, or shortly
before a variable it filled expires.

Citation.title: Citation
Citation.description: A passage the answer leans on. `index` is the number the model writes, as [1].

dimensions.title: Dimensions
dimensions.description: Ask the model for vectors of this size. Unset keeps the model's own size; only models that support shortening accept a different one.

api_key.title: Api Key
api_key.description: Stored encrypted. Unset uses the provider's key from the environment.

ConfigOption.title: ConfigOption
ConfigOption.description: What a member sees when picking a model: no key details.

key_hint.title: Key Hint
key_hint.description: The last characters of the key.

use_environment_key.title: Use Environment Key
use_environment_key.description: Forget the stored key and use the environment's.

ConfigUpdate.title: ConfigUpdate
ConfigUpdate.description: Only the label, the key and availability change: a new model is a new config.

callback_url.title: Callback Url
callback_url.description: Where Composio sends the user after they authorize.

ConnectionFilter.title: ConnectionFilter
ConnectionFilter.description: `not_connected` means "needs a connection the user does not have yet".

status.title: Status
status.description: INITIALIZING, INITIATED, ACTIVE, FAILED, EXPIRED, INACTIVE or REVOKED.

ConnectionResponse.title: ConnectionResponse
ConnectionResponse.description: A connection's status. Credentials never leave Composio, so none appear here.

name.title: Name
name.description: Null when the agent was made private or deleted since.

running_turn_id.title: Running Turn Id
running_turn_id.description: A turn still being written: subscribe to its events.

ConversationUpdate.title: ConversationUpdate
ConversationUpdate.description:
Omitted fields stay. `model_id: null` goes back to the platform default and
`active_agent_id: null` to the assistant on its own.

DocumentVisibility.title: DocumentVisibility
DocumentVisibility.description: `private`: the owner and the people it is shared with. `firm`: every member.

source.title: Source
source.description: A pasted cURL command, or the API's documentation.

EmbeddingOptions.title: EmbeddingOptions
EmbeddingOptions.description: The models a member may pick when uploading, and the one preselected.

EmbeddingPurpose.title: EmbeddingPurpose
EmbeddingPurpose.description:
`tool_search`: the space every tool vector and tool query uses.
`library`: the platform default for documents when a firm has no choice of its own.

EnhancePromptRequest.title: EnhancePromptRequest
EnhancePromptRequest.description: Rough notes from the editor's Generate button.

FeatureSource.title: FeatureSource
FeatureSource.description: Why a firm has (or lacks) a feature: its plan, or a per-firm override.

available.title: Available
available.description: Enabled configs the firm may offer.

FirmEmbeddingUpdate.title: FirmEmbeddingUpdate
FirmEmbeddingUpdate.description: An empty list leaves the firm on the platform default with no member choice.

trial_days.title: Trial Days
trial_days.description: Put the firm on this plan as a trial; it returns to its previous plan after.

status.description: Defaults to active (or trialing with trial_days).

FirmRegistration.title: FirmRegistration
FirmRegistration.description: An admin registers the firm and becomes its first member in one step.

FirmUpdate.title: FirmUpdate
FirmUpdate.description: Replace the firm's name and details. A field left out is cleared: the form sends all.

introspection.title: Introspection
introspection.description: An introspection result as JSON; unset fetches it live.

GrpcMethodInfo.title: GrpcMethodInfo
GrpcMethodInfo.description: One method a proto or a reflecting server offers, with a request skeleton.

IngestionOptions.title: IngestionOptions
IngestionOptions.description:
How to chunk and index a document. Unset fields take the mode's defaults.

smart:   Smart Digest reads a sample and proposes strategy and sizes, plus the
         metric unless `distance_metric` pins one. The plan waits for review.
default: recursive, 512 tokens, 64 overlap, cosine.
custom:  the uploader's own strategy, sizes and metric.

`embedding_config_id` picks one of the firm's embedding options (see
GET /embeddings/options). Unset takes the firm's default on upload and keeps
the document's current config on reprocess.

embedding.description: The config the next indexing embeds with.

indexed_with.description: The config the stored chunks (and search queries) use.

IngestionStatus.title: IngestionStatus
IngestionStatus.description:
Smart Digest: analyzing -> analyzed (the plan waits for the uploader) -> queued.
Default and custom start at queued. Then processing -> ready, failed or unsupported.

InviteAcceptance.title: InviteAcceptance
InviteAcceptance.description: The email comes from the invite, so the invitee cannot join as someone else.

InviteCreated.title: InviteCreated
InviteCreated.description: Returned once: only the token hash is stored, so the link cannot be shown again.

KeySource.title: KeySource
KeySource.description:
Where a config's API key comes from. `unreadable`: stored under an older
SECRETS_ENCRYPTION_KEY and must be entered again.

KeyValue.title: KeyValue
KeyValue.description: One header, query parameter or metadata entry. `value` is a template.

LlmCatalogModel.title: LlmCatalogModel
LlmCatalogModel.description: A chat model from LiteLLM's table, to prefill the add form.

LlmKeySource.title: LlmKeySource
LlmKeySource.description:
Where a provider's key comes from. `unreadable`: stored under an older
SECRETS_ENCRYPTION_KEY and must be entered again.

LlmModelCreate.title: LlmModelCreate
LlmModelCreate.description: Unset limits and capabilities come from LiteLLM's table.

LlmModelOption.title: LlmModelOption
LlmModelOption.description: What a member sees in the model picker: no key details.

is_usable.title: Is Usable
is_usable.description: Enabled, and its provider is enabled with a usable key.

LlmModelUpdate.title: LlmModelUpdate
LlmModelUpdate.description: Provider and model never change: a different model is a new row.

key_hint.title: Key Hint
key_hint.description: The last characters of the key.

use_environment_key.title: Use Environment Key
use_environment_key.description: Forget the stored key and use the environment's.

user_name.title: User Name
user_name.description: Who made the call: their name, or email when they have none.

MemberResponse.title: MemberResponse
MemberResponse.description: A row of the firm's member list.

MessageStatus.title: MessageStatus
MessageStatus.description: `streaming` while the reply is being written; the others are final.

document.title: Document
document.description: The OpenAPI 3 document, JSON or YAML.

PlanChangePreview.title: PlanChangePreview
PlanChangePreview.description: What switching a firm to another plan would change, before anything is saved.

PlanChanges.title: PlanChanges
PlanChanges.description: What the uploader changed in Smart Digest's plan before indexing. Unset keeps it.

features.title: Features
features.description: The complete set of feature keys the plan includes.

PlanLimitsUpdate.title: PlanLimitsUpdate
PlanLimitsUpdate.description: Sets the listed limits; others keep their value. A null value is unlimited.

is_default.title: Is Default
is_default.description: Only true is accepted: another plan becomes the default.

collection.title: Collection
collection.description: A Postman v2.1 collection, as JSON.

ReadMode.title: ReadMode
ReadMode.description:
How the reader shows a file. `pdf` and `image` embed the stored file from `url`;
`markdown` and `text` show extracted `pages`; `unavailable` says why in `reason`.

is_mutating.title: Is Mutating
is_mutating.description: Leave unset to infer it: non-GET REST, GraphQL mutations and webhooks change data; gRPC methods are assumed to.

input_schema.title: Input Schema
input_schema.description: JSON Schema of the params. Unset derives it from the templates.

RequestWrite-Input.title: RequestWrite
RequestWrite-Input.description: Create or replace a request. Exactly the detail block of its protocol is required.

is_mutating.title: Is Mutating
is_mutating.description: Leave unset to infer it: non-GET REST, GraphQL mutations and webhooks change data; gRPC methods are assumed to.

input_schema.title: Input Schema
input_schema.description: JSON Schema of the params. Unset derives it from the templates.

RequestWrite-Output.title: RequestWrite
RequestWrite-Output.description: Create or replace a request. Exactly the detail block of its protocol is required.

RunResult.title: RunResult
RunResult.description: What one execution produced, as the UI and the agent see it.

environment_id.title: Environment Id
environment_id.description: Unset uses the collection's default environment.

SubscriptionMetrics.title: SubscriptionMetrics
SubscriptionMetrics.description:
The numbers that say whether packaging works. Windows are the trailing 30 days
unless noted; ratios are null while their denominator is zero.

SubscriptionStatus.title: SubscriptionStatus
SubscriptionStatus.description:
`trialing`: a time-boxed upgrade; at `trial_ends_at` the firm returns to its previous plan.
`past_due`: billing needs attention; access is kept. `cancelled`: the firm falls back to
the default plan's entitlements.

SubscriptionView.title: SubscriptionView
SubscriptionView.description: What one firm is entitled to right now, and how it got there.

tools_reused.title: Tools Reused
tools_reused.description: Already have a current vector under this config.

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.description: Required: switching re-embeds every tool with the new model.

ToolActionType.title: ToolActionType
ToolActionType.description: Whether running a tool can change data. `write` asks the user before it runs.

run_stalled.title: Run Stalled
run_stalled.description: The run stopped making progress; retry it.

ToolEmbeddingStatus.title: ToolEmbeddingStatus
ToolEmbeddingStatus.description:
`active` serves every tool search. `target` is being built by `run` and replaces
`active` only once every live tool has a current vector under it.

action_type.description: `write` tools, and tools not yet labelled, ask before they run.

ToolResultBlock.title: ToolResultBlock
ToolResultBlock.description: What the model was shown. The full result lives on the tool call row.

include_schemas.title: Include Schemas
include_schemas.description: Also return each tool's input and output parameters.

tools_current.title: Tools Current
tools_current.description: Vector made from the tool's current content.

tools_stale.title: Tools Stale
tools_stale.description: Vector from older content: still searched, re-embedded.

ToolVectorCoverage.title: ToolVectorCoverage
ToolVectorCoverage.description: How much of the live catalog has a vector under one config.

ToolkitNamespace.title: ToolkitNamespace
ToolkitNamespace.description:
Where a toolkit comes from. `composio` toolkits are the shared catalog the sync
mirrors (`firm_id` null); `custom` toolkits belong to one firm, which builds them
in `features/custom_toolkits`.

agent_id.title: Agent Id
agent_id.description: The attached agent that answers. Send null for the assistant on its own; leave it out to keep the conversation's current choice.

key.title: Key
key.description: The group's value: a day, model, id or purpose.

label.title: Label
label.description: A readable name for an id key.

UserRole.title: UserRole
UserRole.description:
`super_admin` runs the platform (embedding settings, the tool catalog) and passes
every role check; it is granted only by `scripts/super_admin.py`. `admin` runs one firm.

UserSummary.title: UserSummary
UserSummary.description: Who someone is, for pickers and owner labels inside a firm.

VariableResponse.title: VariableResponse
VariableResponse.description: A secret's value is never returned: only that it is set, and its last characters.
